vsm1.3:51.2: Taṃ sajjhāyādīhi niccabyāvaṭassa palibodho hoti, na itarassa.
vsm1.3:51.6: Thero kīdisosi, āvuso, pariyattiyanti pucchi. Majjhimo me, bhante, paguṇoti.
vsm1.3:51.11: Bhante, tumhākaṃ santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ labhitvā puna na olokessāmīti
vsm1.3:51.17: apica kho kataparicayo ahamettha ārabhathā’’ti vatvā
vsm1.3:51.18: ādito paṭṭhāya yāva pariyosānā ekabyañjanepissa kaṅkhā nāhosi.
vsm1.3:52.3: Tesaṃ gāmavāsikattherehi saddhiṃ saṃsandentānaṃ ekapañhopi uppaṭipāṭiyā āgato nāhosi.
vsm1.3:53.1: Mahāvihārepi tipiṭakacūḷābhayatthero nāma aṭṭhakathaṃ anuggahetvāva pañcanikāyamaṇḍale tīṇi piṭakāni parivattessāmīti suvaṇṇabheriṃ paharāpesi.
vsm1.3:53.4: attano ācariyuggahaññeva vadatu, itarathā vattuṃ na demāti āha.
vsm1.3:53.5: Upajjhāyopi naṃ attano upaṭṭhānamāgataṃ pucchi ‘‘tvamāvuso, bheriṃ paharāpesī’’ti?
vsm1.3:53.9: Āvuso abhaya, ācariyā idaṃ padaṃ kathaṃ vadantīti?
vsm1.3:53.12: Puna so aññena aññena pariyāyena evaṃ vadanti bhanteti tikkhattuṃ āha.
vsm1.3:53.15: ācariyamukhato pana anuggahitattā ‘evaṃ ācariyā vadantī’ti saṇṭhātuṃ nāsakkhi.
vsm1.3:53.16: Gaccha attano ācariyānaṃ santike suṇāhī’’ti. Kuhiṃ, bhante, gacchāmīti?
vsm1.3:53.21: pañcahi bhikkhusatehi saddhiṃ therassa santikaṃ gantvā
vsm1.3:53.23: Thero kasmā āgatosīti pucchi. Dhammaṃ sotuṃ, bhanteti.
vsm1.3:53.24: Āvuso abhaya, dīghamajjhimesu maṃ kālena kālaṃ pucchanti.
vsm1.3:53.25: Avasesaṃ pana me tiṃsamattāni vassāni na olokitapubbaṃ.
vsm1.3:53.26: Apica tvaṃ rattiṃ mama santike parivattehi.
vsm1.3:54.1: Pariveṇadvāre mahāmaṇḍapaṃ kāretvā gāmavāsino divase divase dhammassavanatthāya āgacchanti.
vsm1.3:54.2: Thero rattiṃ parivatti. Taṃ divā kathayanto anupubbena desanaṃ niṭṭhapetvā
vsm1.3:54.5: Bhante, kiṃ bhaṇatha, nanu mayā tumhākameva santike sutaṃ? Kimahaṃ tumhehi aññātaṃ kathessāmīti?
vsm1.3:54.6: Tato naṃ thero añño esa, āvuso, gatakassa maggo nāmāti āha.
vsm1.3:55.9: So attano dhammantevāsikassa santike taṭṭikāya nisīditvā
vsm1.3:56.2: Sā hi uttānaseyyakadārako viya taruṇasassaṃ viya ca dupparihārā hoti. Appamattakeneva bhijjati.
vsm1.3:56.3: Sā pana vipassanāya palibodho hoti, na samādhissa, samādhiṃ patvā pattabbato.
vsm1.3:57.4: Tattha sabbatthakakammaṭṭhānaṃ nāma bhikkhusaṅghādīsu mettā maraṇassati ca.
vsm1.3:58.2: paṭhamaṃ tāva paricchinditvā sīmaṭṭhakabhikkhusaṅghe sukhitā hontu abyāpajjāti
vsm1.3:58.7: So hi bhikkhusaṅghe mettāya sahavāsīnaṃ muducittataṃ janeti.
vsm1.3:58.9: Sīmaṭṭhakadevatāsu mettāya mudukatacittāhi devatāhi dhammikāya rakkhāya susaṃvihitarakkho hoti.
vsm1.3:58.11: mudukatacittasantānehi issarehi dhammikāya rakkhāya surakkhitaparikkhāro hoti.
vsm1.3:58.12: Tattha manussesu mettāya pasāditacittehi tehi aparibhūto hutvā vicarati.
vsm1.3:58.18: Asubhasaññāparicitacittassa panassa dibbānipi ārammaṇāni lobhavasena cittaṃ na pariyādiyanti.
vsm1.3:59.1: Evaṃ bahūpakārattā sabbattha atthayitabbaṃ icchitabbanti ca
vsm1.3:60.1: Cattālīsāya pana kammaṭṭhānesu yaṃ yassa cariyānukūlaṃ,
vsm1.3:60.3: uparimassa ca uparimassa bhāvanākammassa padaṭṭhānattā pārihāriyakammaṭṭhānanti vuccati.
vsm1.3:60.4: Iti imaṃ duvidhampi kammaṭṭhānaṃ yo deti, ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyako nāma. Taṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ.
vsm1.3:61.2: Piyo garu bhāvanīyo, vattā ca vacanakkhamo;
vsm1.3:61.3: Gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā, no caṭṭhāne niyojakoti. (a. ni. 7.37);
vsm1.3:61.4: Evamādiguṇasamannāgataṃ ekantena hitesiṃ vuddhipakkhe ṭhitaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ.
vsm1.3:62.1: ‘‘Mamaṃ hi, ānanda, kalyāṇamittaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccantī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 1.129; 5.2) ādivacanato pana
vsm1.3:62.3: Tasmā tasmiṃ sati tasseva bhagavato santike gahitakammaṭṭhānaṃ sugahitaṃ hoti.
vsm1.3:62.4: Parinibbute pana tasmiṃ asītiyā mahāsāvakesu yo dharati, tassa santike gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.3:62.6: yaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetukāmo hoti, tasseva vasena catukkapañcakajjhānāni nibbattetvā
vsm1.3:62.7: jhānapadaṭṭhānaṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā āsavakkhayappattassa khīṇāsavassa santike gahetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:63.1: Kiṃ pana khīṇāsavo ahaṃ khīṇāsavoti attānaṃ pakāsetīti?
vsm1.3:63.2: Kiṃ vattabbaṃ, kārakabhāvaṃ hi jānitvā pakāseti.
vsm1.3:63.3: Nanu assaguttatthero āraddhakammaṭṭhānassa bhikkhuno ‘‘kammaṭṭhānakārako aya’’nti jānitvā ākāse cammakhaṇḍaṃ paññāpetvā tattha pallaṅkena nisinno kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathesīti.
vsm1.3:64.1: Tasmā sace khīṇāsavaṃ labhati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
vsm1.3:64.5: yassa ekasaṅgītipi aṭṭhakathāya saddhiṃ paguṇā, ayañca lajjī hoti, tassa santike gahetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:64.6: Evarūpo hi tantidharo vaṃsānurakkhako paveṇīpālako ācariyo
vsm1.3:64.8: Teneva porāṇakattherā ‘‘lajjī rakkhissati lajjī rakkhissatī’’ti tikkhattuṃ āhaṃsu.
vsm1.3:65.4: taṃ taṃ ācariyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā uggahaparipucchānaṃ visodhitattā
vsm1.3:65.5: ito cito ca suttañca kāraṇañca sallakkhetvā sappāyāsappāyaṃ yojetvā gahanaṭṭhāne gacchanto mahāhatthī viya mahāmaggaṃ dassento kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathessati.
vsm1.3:66.1: Sace panetaṃ ekavihāreyeva labhati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce labhati, yattha so vasati, tattha gantabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:66.2: Gacchantena ca na dhotamakkhitehi pādehi upāhanā ārūhitvā
vsm1.3:66.7: antarāmagge yaṃ yaṃ vihāraṃ pavisati sabbattha vattapaṭipattiṃ kurumānena
vsm1.3:66.11: antarāmaggeyeva dantakaṭṭhaṃ kappiyaṃ kārāpetvā gahetvā pavisitabbaṃ,
vsm1.3:66.12: na ca ‘‘muhuttaṃ vissametvā pādadhovanamakkhanādīni katvā ācariyassa santikaṃ gamissāmī’’ti aññaṃ pariveṇaṃ pavisitabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:67.2: Sace hissa tatra ācariyassa visabhāgā bhikkhū bhaveyyuṃ,
vsm1.3:67.3: te āgamanakāraṇaṃ pucchitvā ācariyassa avaṇṇaṃ pakāsetvā
vsm1.3:67.7: tasmā ācariyassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pucchitvā ujukaṃ tattheva gantabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:68.1: Sace ācariyo daharataro hoti, pattacīvarapaṭiggahaṇādīni na sāditabbāni.
vsm1.3:68.2: Sace vuḍḍhataro hoti, gantvā ācariyaṃ vanditvā ṭhātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:68.5: ‘‘Pāde dhovāhī’’ti vuttena na tāva pādā dhovitabbā.
vsm1.3:68.6: Sace hi ācariyena ābhataṃ udakaṃ bhaveyya, na sāruppaṃ siyā.
vsm1.3:68.7: ‘‘Dhovāhāvuso, na mayā ābhataṃ, aññehi ābhata’’nti vuttena pana
vsm1.3:68.8: yattha ācariyo na passati, evarūpe paṭicchanne vā okāse,
vsm1.3:68.9: abbhokāse vihārassāpi vā ekamante nisīditvā pādā dhovitabbā.
vsm1.3:69.1: Sace ācariyo telanāḷiṃ āharati uṭṭhahitvā ubhohi hatthehi sakkaccaṃ gahetabbā.
vsm1.3:69.2: Sace hi na gaṇheyya, ‘‘ayaṃ bhikkhu ito eva paṭṭhāya sambhogaṃ kopetī’’ti ācariyassa aññathattaṃ bhaveyya.
vsm1.3:69.3: Gahetvā pana na āditova pādā makkhetabbā.
vsm1.3:69.4: Sace hi taṃ ācariyassa gattabbhañjanatelaṃ bhaveyya, na sāruppaṃ siyā.
vsm1.3:69.8: ‘‘imaṃ telanāḷiṃ ṭhapemi, bhante’’ti vatvā ācariye gaṇhante dātabbā.
vsm1.3:70.1: Āgatadivasato paṭṭhāya kammaṭṭhānaṃ me, bhante, kathetha iccevaṃ na vattabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:70.2: Dutiyadivasato pana paṭṭhāya sace ācariyassa pakatiupaṭṭhāko atthi, taṃ yācitvā vattaṃ kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:70.3: Sace yācitopi na deti, okāse laddheyeva kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:70.5: Sītaṃ uṇhanti duvidhaṃ mukhadhovanaudakañca nhānodakañca paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:70.6: Tato yaṃ ācariyo tīṇi divasāni paribhuñjati, tādisameva niccaṃ upanāmetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:70.7: Niyamaṃ akatvā yaṃ vā taṃ vā paribhuñjantassa yathāladdhaṃ upanāmetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:71.5: kālasseva uṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ,
vsm1.3:71.8: Sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā’’ti (mahāva. 78) ādikaṃ khandhake sammāvattaṃ paññattaṃ, taṃ sabbampi kātabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:72.4: yadā so kissāgatosīti pucchati, tadā āgamanakāraṇaṃ kathetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:72.5: Sace so neva pucchati, vattaṃ pana sādiyati,
vsm1.3:72.9: Akāle vā gantvā kimatthamāgatosīti puṭṭhena ārocetabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:73.1: Sace so pātova āgacchāti vadati, pātova gantabbaṃ.
vsm1.3:73.2: Sace panassa tāya velāya pittābādhena vā kucchi pariḍayhati,
vsm1.3:73.8: Asappāyavelāya hi vuccamānampi kammaṭṭhānaṃ na sakkā hoti manasikātunti.
vsm1.3:73.9: Ayaṃ kammaṭṭhānadāyakaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ upasaṅkamitvāti ettha vitthāro.
